description: This file is a shell script used for testing the diff-highlight tool, which is part of a version control workflow (using git). It defines various test cases to validate the behavior of diff-highlight with different diff scenarios, including highlighting, color, graph visualization, and complex diff cases.

methods.name: dh_test
methods.description: Function to perform diff highlighting test between two files, comparing the output to an expected result.

methods.name: dh_test_setup_history
methods.description: Sets up a git history graph with commits and branches for testing diff highlight with graph output.

methods.name: left_trim
methods.description: Removes leading whitespace from input, used for processing diff outputs.

methods.name: trim_graph
methods.description: Removes graph-specific characters from diff output to facilitate comparison.
